construction: Original explicit qmg_core source recipe; no automatic CLI motif selection and no model-weight training

byte_reproducibility.observation: Final full build changed lighting bytes while source MAP, canonical layout and compiled analysis remained unchanged. Final smoke and preview evidence bind the exact delivered BSP.

translations.observation: Two physical lifts and two directed teleporter links create distinct ascent/arrival arrangements.
translations.application: Separate ordinary circulation, optional physical ascent and one committed remote arrival.

translations.observation: Faceted spaces coexist with a lift and a directed height shortcut; small rotating screens are not traversable doors.
translations.application: Author original faceted encounters and classify mechanisms by actual role.

translations.observation: Chamfered encounter boundaries and three lifts coexist without a teleporter.
translations.application: Treat encounter shape and traversal mechanisms as independent design variables in later controlled tests.

research.rights: No archive geometry, assets or external implementation copied. Torn Glory author restriction against using the map as a base is respected.
limits: Reference AAS files have zero reachabilities and unverified BSP association.
No new reference-map engine play was performed.
Author/archive capacity conflicts for Torn Glory and Bio Rust remain unresolved.

static_checks.lighting: extra4, one bounce, soft shadows; no empty lightmaps

mechanism_checks.ordinary_route_policy: walk, step and bounded drop; lift, teleporter and jump edges excluded

static_checks.collision_method: exact vertical convex prism versus AABB, positive-volume overlap

repository_tests.final_end_to_end_build: Passed generation, QBSP, full VIS, lighting, compiled inspection and preview export after the focused tests.

limits: Dedicated server only: no engine render target or lighting/readability evidence.
No connected players: no spawn selection, pickup contact, traversal, mover activation or teleporter-use test.
Checks native entity initialization and scheduled autonomous physics ticks; absence of diagnostics is a smoke result, not a balance or reachability proof.
dumpents exports the authored BSP entity text, not live edict origins or mover state.
The standard legacy module exposes no live entity-state dump server command; lift initial state is not established by this check.
Read-only assets and a copied executable/module are local test dependencies, not bundled map content or project-linked libraries.

topology.ordinary_path_policy: walk, step and bounded drop; lift, teleporter and jump edges excluded
topology.interpretation: Fewer edges and a smaller footprint are descriptors, not evidence of better connectivity, tighter flow or lower central control.

lift.ordinary_bypass: No Hall 128-to-256 stair. Ordinary ascent goes through Spool and Switchroom and returns along the upper Hall passage.

limits: Multiple design variables changed; this is not a controlled causal comparison.
Current costs include endpoint approaches but remain Manhattan/node-center estimates. Earlier artifacts use a different timing basis; do not compare their costs or call them measured travel time.
Point LOS is not a match, spawn-safety guarantee or rendered lighting check.

knowledge_cards.evidence: All 264 ordinary paths pass with jump, lift and teleporter edges excluded. Hall upper ascent still incurs a route through Spool and Switchroom.
knowledge_cards.candidate_rule: A mechanism can be optional while materially changing commitment and journey cost.
knowledge_cards.falsification_test: Matched Hall starts show whether wait plus ride plus exit reliably beats the ordinary route, and under which defender/platform states it becomes a trap.

knowledge_cards.evidence: Kiln arrival faces a chaingun approximately 97 XY units away; an upper spawn is approximately 113 XY units behind the arrival.
knowledge_cards.candidate_rule: Audit destination resources and spawn-to-arrival exposure separately from spawn-pair LOS.
knowledge_cards.falsification_test: Compare the same onward goal with teleport on/off; log weapon acquisition, damage and deaths within three seconds of arrival under matched defender positions.

knowledge_cards.evidence: Hall has five incident passages versus Spillway maximum four; room edges decrease from ten to eight and cycle rank from five to four.
knowledge_cards.candidate_rule: Edge count alone cannot establish distributed flow.
knowledge_cards.falsification_test: At 2, 4 and 6 players compare Hall traffic share, sustained control, contested entrances and unused alternative paths.

knowledge_cards.evidence: World diagonal decreases from 2952.1 to 2643.3 while sampled LOS median grows from 215.0 to 240.0 and p90 from 555.3 to 668.7.
knowledge_cards.candidate_rule: Measure footprint and sightline distributions independently.
knowledge_cards.falsification_test: Controlled geometry-only variants should preserve item/mechanism state while evaluating pursuit breaks and long-angle control in actual play.

knowledge_cards.evidence: Pinned dedicated engine accepts final Counterweight and unchanged Spillway; a buried pickup fixture is rejected through native droptofloor diagnostics despite exit code zero.
knowledge_cards.candidate_rule: Native initialization diagnostics supplement static hull validation but do not validate player traversal.
knowledge_cards.falsification_test: Keep the negative control and reject any driver revision that accepts it or fails to bind exact BSP/module identities.

play_regimen.design: matched-start 2x2 lift activation by teleporter activation
play_regimen.activation_control: Prepare a separately hashed test module with verified activation toggles. Preserve world geometry, items, timers, disc models/collision and movement settings. Disabled lift remains at the lower station; targetname is not an equivalent disable because it changes native initial state.

lift_matched_journeys.finish: same goal beyond upper Hall exit
lift_matched_journeys.off_state: platform parked below; player/defender starts matched to corresponding active trial
lift_matched_journeys.not_applicable: Off-condition ride and wait are missing/not applicable, not zero.

arrival_conditions: defender at nearby upper spawn behind arrival

populated_rounds.counterbalance: Rotate matched starts and participants across conditions; record familiarity and rule settings. Analyze each population separately.
populated_rounds.reporting: Keep failures and variation alongside medians; do not promote rules from a single match or small unreplicated difference.

play_regimen.input_control: No input automation performed or authorized by this study. Any later automated keyboard/mouse action requires specific permission.
play_regimen.rendering_evidence: Any later rendering validation must use a windowed engine and its registered screenshot command.

inference_limits: Multiple design variables changed; this is not a controlled causal comparison.
Current costs include endpoint approaches but remain Manhattan/node-center estimates. Earlier artifacts use a different timing basis; do not compare their costs or call them measured travel time.
Point LOS is not a match, spawn-safety guarantee or rendered lighting check.
No engine traversal, lift activation, teleporter use, live edict initial-state observation, rendered readability or multiplayer match evidence.
Spawn-pair LOS does not measure spawn-to-teleport-arrival exposure or guarantee spawn safety.
Straight-line item distances are not route times; upward world area includes trim and is not measured walkable area.
The 30 jump graph edges are excluded from the ordinary reachability claim.
Multiple shape, item and traversal variables changed from Spillway; this is exploration, not controlled causal improvement.
No model weights trained; generated example excluded from reference-profile calibration; no archive geometry copied.

Open engineering issues are tracked in knowledge/q2/iteration-roadmap.json: default 32-unit stair treads, stock client focus behavior, origin-versus-eye LOS sampling, and separate geometry/state precision limits.
